## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `TurboDL-Setup-0.5.1.exe` | Windows 10/11 (x64) |
| `TurboDL-0.5.1-arm64.dmg` | macOS on Apple Silicon (M1 and newer) |
| `TurboDL-0.5.1-x64.dmg` | macOS on Intel |
| `TurboDL-Firefox-0.5.1.xpi` | the Firefox add-on |

## What's new

- **The macOS apps are signed and notarized by Apple.** TurboDL now opens like any other app: no "Apple could not verify…" warning, no trip to Privacy & Security.

Everything else is as in 0.5.0 (Instagram links, Saved, profiles and highlights).

## Updating

- Install the new version over the old one and open TurboDL once.
- If you installed 0.5.0 on a Mac with **Open Anyway** or `xattr`, just replace it with this version.
- Firefox: open `TurboDL-Firefox-0.5.1.xpi` in Firefox. Regular Firefox only installs add-ons signed by Mozilla; if this file is unsigned, use Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR with `xpinstall.signatures.required` set to `false`.

The Windows installer is not signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
